items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I heard him quite a few times, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, speaking of other clarinetists, on this old Edison machine, this is one of the old time machines, it has these real thick... We found a few records with the Yellow Nunez and the Louisiana Five. Do you remember anything about Yellow Nunez hearing him much?
Well, Yellow was a very fine clarinet player. I heard him quite a few times, yeah.
On these records they don't have a carnet, just... No, I understand he...
